content:
The “Patricia’s Sunset Cocktails” playlist from episode 4 of Widow’s Bay’s first season is now available on Apple Music. Get it below.

811 songs, 60 hours 31 minutes

Earlier tonight, the Apple TV account on X published a post linking to a new Apple Music playlist called “Patricia’s Sunset Cocktails Playlist!”

Although the post says this is a 300-song playlist, the actual playlist features 811 tracks, totaling more than 60 hours of music.

The playlist is credited to Patricia, whose Apple Music username is @mayoroffice. Its description reads, “Dale, here is the first batch. – Patricia,” which, much like the playlist’s length and overall theme, will probably make more sense to Apple TV subscribers who have watched Widow’s Bay episode “Beach Reads.”

That said, even if you haven’t watched it, the playlist looks like a lot of fun and could very well become your next go-to party soundtrack.
